title: Flexible sodium-ion batteries with reversible multi-electron redox mechanism and an advanced electrolyte–electrode interface
content:
Sustainable Energy Fuels, 2026, 10,1234-1258
DOI: 10.1039/D5SE01143D, Review Article
Tapan Dey, Saikat Dutta
This review highlights key advances in flexible SIBs, focusing on anode and cathode materials, electrolytes, and electrolyte–electrode interfaces, with emphasis on flexibility and sodium-ion insertion/diffusion mechansim.
